messages:
Amina Patel: FYI — noticed a couple of inconsistencies between the in-console docs panel and the docs site this morning. Terms like \"model flavor\" show up in Console but the docs and API use \"model variant\". Also the in-product help links jump to the top of the docs page instead of the correct anchor.
Liz Chen: ugh. Where in the console copy is \"model flavor\" used? I thought we had standardized on \"variant\" last quarter. :thinking_face:
Amina Patel: Found two places: the model picker dropdown and the rollout modal copy. Quick snippet from the UI i18n file:
```
{ \"picker\": { \"label\": \"Choose model flavor\" }, \"rollout\": { \"desc\": \"Roll out a model flavor to traffic\" } }
```
Samir Rao: Thanks — we should 1) change the strings to \"model variant\" 2) make sure analytics uses the new key so dashboards don't break. I can put up a tiny PR for the i18n keys.
Jorge Silva: On anchors: the console panel opens docs in a new tab to /docs/models but we append the fragment as a query param `?section=kv-cache` because of internal routing. The docs site doesn't read that param. We should change the console to open /docs/models#kv-cache or update docs to ingest the param. My vote: update console to use real anchor links so browser jump works and GA event still fires.
Elaine Park: Also flagging an accessibility issue — when the help panel opens, focus stays on the panel but keyboard focus order after following a link is inconsistent. Screen reader users end up in the page body before the heading. We need a focus management pattern: set focus to the main heading or add `aria-describedby` + skip link.
Liz Chen: Good catch Elaine. For copy: Amina, can you list all occurrences? I'll run a quick grep and update the terminology doc. We should include a line in the in-product docs panel that says "Terminology: we use \"model variant\"" so users don't get confused.
Amina Patel: Yep — I ran grep on the monorepo and found 5 occurrences in Console + 1 in a legacy onboarding flow. I'll add them to the PR description.
Samir Rao: For the anchor change I'll add a small router util to build deep links: `buildDocLink(path, anchor)` and replace the current `openDocs(path, {section})` call sites. That keeps analytics call the same but fixes browser jump.
Jorge Silva: That util sounds good. If anyone touches docs site, please coordinate — we might need to keep a fallback that reads `?section=` for older links for 2-3 weeks.
docbot: Related docs PR: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/docs/pulls/322 contains anchor id fixes (kv-cache -> #kv-cache, batching -> #batching).
Elaine Park: One more accessibility nit — the in-product panel needs role=\"dialog\" + `aria-modal=\"true\"` and a visible focus outline for the first interactive element. Right now the close button isn't reachable by keyboard from some keyboard configs.
Liz Chen: I'll task eng with the role + focus outline changes. Amina, can you add a short in-console blurb about terminology as you suggested? Keep it one line.
Amina Patel: Will do. Plan: Samir opens i18n PR + router util (small change), Jorge adds fallback plan, Liz updates docs and console blurb, Elaine verifies focus/role changes and tests with NVDA. Targeting rollout in next canary on Thursday. :+1:
Samir Rao: PRs coming in today. I'll ping here once merged.
Jorge Silva: I'll add a tiny runbook note — how to handle old anchors during the rollback window.
Elaine Park: I'll run keyboard + screenreader pass after the canary. If I see anything else I'll post snips here.
Amina Patel: Thanks all. Quick win and accessibility improvement — nice. :rocket:
